Get well looked after at Rice Bistro
Nov 2025 • Couples
Rice Bistro is located in the Old Quarter of Hanoi. This family run restaurant has been operating since 1994 having moved to this premises some years ago.
If you are looking for a really good taste of Vietnamese food you need look no further than Rice Bistro.
Lots of visitors to Hanoi have the view that, if you are not sitting on a small plastic chair in a laneway, you are not somehow getting the full flavour of Viet Nam.
This is not the case. The people behind Rice Bistro started small, served good food, did well and moved to larger quarters adjacent to a hotel.
Do not be put off by the fact this restaurant is part of a hotel. The family behind it know their food and have been serving it up for years.
We first ate here in 2023 and returned in 2025. We had an excellent meal once again. Chi and Linda were attentive and informed as our wait staff and despite it being a quiet night we enjoyed the atmosphere and were extremely well looked after.
Give it a try.

Thank you for visiting our restaurant and for sharing your feedback.

We’re truly sorry that you didn’t feel welcome and that your experience with both food and service was disappointing. Your comment about the sticky rice was noted, and we sincerely apologize for the miscommunication. We've addressed this internally to ensure clearer and more attentive service in the future.
We would also like to take this opportunity to provide a bit more context about the dishes you were served.

At our restaurant, the dishes you ordered — especially those prepared with sticky rice — are among the most frequently requested by our regular guests. In particular, the Tây Bắc Grilled Chicken Roll served with Brown sticky rice (gạo lứt nếp cẩm) is a signature item that many health-conscious diners appreciate for its high nutritional value.
Regarding the rice: the dish you ordered comes with Brown sticky rice (gạo lứt nếp cẩm), which is known for its rich nutrients but has a firmer, less sticky texture due to the natural bran layer. However, we understand that Brown sticky rice with its natural bran layer can be a little firmer and less sticky compared to white glutinous rice. Some guests love it for its health benefits, while others may find it less enjoyable. You can find it clearly when enjoy our sticky rice with lotus-wrapped chicken, Char-grilled Pork With Sticky Rice and Tây Bắc Grilled Chicken Roll With Brown Rice

Upon your request, our staff did switch to white sticky rice at no additional charge, which we hope made your meal more comfortable. While these dishes are among our most popular with local and international guests, we understand that tastes can vary — especially for children — and we truly appreciate your honest input. We’ll use your feedback to keep improving.
We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back and provide a better experience next time.
Warm regards,
